text: Welcome to Subarna Mandal (Ph.D.) and Kevin McGuinness (M.Sc.), and to Lily and Josh, who join us for their CHEM 4710 honours projects.

Abishek presented a poster at the Gordon Research Conference: “Rationalizing the Synthesis of Noncentrosymmetric Chalcoarsenates: A<sub>2x</sub>Sr<sub>3−x</sub>(AsS<sub>4</sub>)<sub>n</sub> (A = Na, K)”.
Dinner with solid-state chemistry groups from across Canada.
Dewin gave his first talk at the Solid State Symposium and won an award for his oral presentation.
Our first paper as a group appeared in Chemistry of Materials, on noncentrosymmetric Sr3As2S7 and Sr3As2Se2.5S4.5, in a special issue honouring Mercouri Kanatzidis.
Vinuja Fernando joined as a Ph.D. student, and Nyx and Mateo joined for summer projects on chemical vapor transport and ion exchange.
Taiwo Ogundimu presented her CHEM 4710 project on using machine learning to identify ternary chalcogenides for photovoltaics. Thank you, Taiwo, for your time in the group!
Dewin started his graduate studies on new noncentrosymmetric structures, and Taiwo joined for her honours project.
Abishek spoke at the solid-state chemistry symposium. Thanks to Mario and Jenny for the photo.
An end-of-summer dinner with the solid-state crew, including Dr. Mario Bieringer’s group and Dr. Joey Lussier. Thanks to Tyson, Hyewon, Manya and Dewin for a productive summer.
Vidyanshu presented a poster at the North American Solid State Chemistry Conference in Ames, Iowa, on tuning arsenic coordination to move from centrosymmetric to noncentrosymmetric structures.
Group hot pot with Dr. Bieringer’s students Jenny and Bobbi.
Manya Rishi joined as an NSERC USRA researcher, alongside Tyson, Hyewon and Dewin. Tyson later presented his poster at the UManitoba Undergraduate Research Showcase.
The lab received an NSERC Discovery Grant.
Dr. Vidyanshu Mishra joined as our first postdoctoral researcher.
Abishek was awarded a Tier II Canada Research Chair in Solid-state Materials for Sustainable Energy.
